gold: Ipsilateral hemisphere hemorrhagic stroke with peripheral-type facial paralysis

selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including incomplete closure of the right eye, flattening of the right nasolabial fold, and right-sided hemiplegia, along with imaging studies showing hemorrhage in the left thalamus-radiation crown region, are most consistent with a stroke.

rejected.label: Corticobulbar tract lesion
rejected.why: While the corticobulbar tract appeared thinner on the left side, this finding is not sufficient to explain the patient's symptoms and imaging results.

rejected.label: Thalamic hemorrhage
rejected.why: Although thalamic hemorrhage is present, it is not the most comprehensive explanation for the patient's presentation, which is more consistent with a stroke.
